title: Bechet down and out before the school
summary: The interviewer recalls Bechet's pressing shop in 1939 and his Nick's period; Wilber agrees.

story.theme_name: Making a living: hard times, day jobs and scarce work
story.community_name: The Depression years and the WPA band

blocks.x: So I remember back in 1939 when he was, had a pressing shop up there. Yeah. It was out of music altogether.
We'd go up there and eat and take some food. I remember once we took a bag of sweet potatoes and Fred Ramsey and I went up to see him one night. Yeah. He was really down and out practically.
A few years before that and he started working at Nick's about that time too.
The Spirits of Rhythm and that group. Yeah.
Yeah, Zutty. And he and Zutty didn't get along and then they had to decide, ride up the band somehow.
